bootstrap.estimator: retain every frame in each sampled scene; equal-frame target, not equal-scene mean
bootstrap.corrected_ci: conditional on N<P, nonnegative noise, finite positive powers, and |corrected rho|<=1+1e-10; coverage reported for every band
bootstrap.label_probability: resampling frequency, not a Bayesian probability or population class probability

correction_policy: N>=P, negative noise, nonfinite/nonpositive powers, or |corrected rho|>1+1e-10 invalidate the primary correction. Only numerical overruns within 1e-10 are clipped. Raw moment estimate is retained separately.
uncertainty_limits: Conditions on first within-scene/exposure noise pair and fitted gains; scene bootstrap does not separately model finite noise-pair selection uncertainty.
